# Leon Kosciak
## Leon Kosciak
### Tenure
2025
**Leon Kosciak** is a Polish-American automotive designer who interned at Mattel from June to August 2025. Prior to working at Mattel he interned at a number of automotive design firms and worked as a graphic designer at other firms. He studied at the College for Creative Studies and ArtCenter.
